ns2:section.sectionText: The goal of this professional development course is to prepare MSF students for a career in the finance field. A strong focus of the course will be helping students develop their professional communication and networking skills. Effective communication skills are critical to the success of future business leaders. These skills will help establish credibility and effective leadership among peers and colleagues.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Finance -UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, MS: Finance - UIUC, or MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC.
